# COVER FX Glitter Drops, 0.5 Fl Oz

## Add Dimension and Sparkle to Any Look

Ultra-concentrated Glitter Drops give you a lustrous glow exactly where you want it. Wear them alone, layer them over or under your makeup, or stir a few drops into your favorite beauty product to customize your shimmer.

## Features That Blend Seamlessly

The weightless, light-reflecting formula blends easily and glides on smoothly. Mix two or more shades to create a one-of-a-kind glow that suits your style.

## Benefits for Your Daily Routine

Because the formula is ultra-concentrated, a small amount goes a long way. You can experiment with new combinations and turn everyday makeup into a creative outlet.

## Clean Ingredients, Bold Results

COVER FX was founded on the belief that clean ingredients and high performance can coexist in one brand. Mix, experiment, and play to create your own formula for beauty.

## Shop Your Signature Glow

Add this 0.5 fl oz bottle to your collection for $9.84, and start creating a glow that's entirely yours.
